About PunjToon

A taste of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa in Lahore

PunjToon is a desi restaurant in Model Town specialising in the food of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The kitchen is best known for its authentic Chapli Kebabs — the flat, spiced kebabs the region is famous for — alongside KPK regional specialities.

Find us at Bank Square Market in Model Town, settle into the outdoor seating, and stay late: the kitchen keeps serving until 1:45 AM.

  • ✓ Authentic Chapli Kebabs, made the KPK way
  • ✓ Khyber Pakhtunkhwa regional specialities
  • ✓ Outdoor seating at Bank Square Market
  • ✓ Late-night dining — open till 1:45 AM
